name: Circuit Studio
author: Code Fry Dev
description: Interactive SPICE-grade analog & digital schematic CAD studio and real-time MNA circuit simulator.
releaseNotes: Add Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool self-documentation using raw string literals, complete EDA/CAD documentation suite, semantic net/component labeling, and dynamic parameter modification.

DefaultPreset.label: Default Circuit Preset
DefaultPreset.description: The initial circuit demo loaded when the studio opens.

ShowCurrentAnnotations.label: Show Current Annotations
ShowCurrentAnnotations.description: Display live animated current flow arrows and branch current readings on wires.

ShowVoltageAnnotations.label: Show Voltage Annotations
ShowVoltageAnnotations.description: Display live node voltage badges at component pins and junctions.

OperatingTemperature.label: Operating Temperature Preset
OperatingTemperature.description: Thermal physics model for semiconductor diodes, BJTs, and quantum junctions.
